title: Auditable Clinical Support with Decision Agents
abstract: arXiv:2611.23700v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Clinicians reviewing a diagnostic work-up will ask what was considered at each step and why the assessment changed. Agents powered by free text can reach physician-level diagnostic accuracy, but their written reasoning does not always reflect the factors that went into the decision. Here, we present Decision2Care, a decision agent that works up the acutely ill patient without producing any text. A decision model assigns a probability to each permitted EHR action, and fixed rules carry out the most probable one. We evaluated Decision2Care on the records of 546 emergency admissions across 12 diseases. Decision2Care reached a diagnostic accuracy of 86.5%, compared with 86.1% for the MIRA-v2 agent, and required a median of 2.2 s per work-up, compared with 92-100 s. translated_title: 基于决策智能体的可审计临床支持
translated_abstract: 临床医生在审查诊断检查时会询问每一步考虑了什么，以及评估为何发生变化。基于自由文本驱动的智能体可以达到医生级别的诊断准确性，但其书写的推理并不总是反映决策背后的实际考量因素。本文提出了Decision2Care，一个无需产生任何文本即可对急危重症患者进行诊断检查的决策智能体。决策模型为每个允许的电子健康记录（EHR）操作分配一个概率，并由固定规则执行概率最高的操作。我们在涵盖12种疾病的546例急诊入院记录上评估了Decision2Care。Decision2Care达到了86.5%的诊断准确率，相比之下MIRA-v2智能体为86.1%；每次检查所需的中位时间为2.2秒，相比之下为92-100秒。每次检查都追踪记录了Decision2Care在每一步正在考虑的选项。在12种疾病中的10种中，鉴别诊断在指南所……
tldr: Decision2Care是一种完全不产生文本的决策智能体，通过为EHR操作分配概率并用固定规则执行最高概率操作，实现了与文本智能体相当的诊断准确率（86.5%），速度提升约40倍，且每一步决策均可审计追踪。
en_tdlr: Decision2Care is a text-free decision agent that assigns probabilities to permitted EHR actions and executes the most probable one via fixed rules, achieving diagnostic accuracy comparable to text-based agents (86.5%) while being roughly 40x faster and fully auditable at every step.
